@IEA
 says that global oil demand will post in 2026 its first year-on-year contraction since 2020 during Covid-19 pandemic. 

The agency forecasts global oil demand falling ~100,000 b/d in 2026 (vs its expectation of +700,000 b/d growth a month ago).
